tasks.title: Create BaseStageRunner abstract class
tasks.description: Create `BaseStageRunner` in a new file `workflow/base-stage-runner.ts`. It implements the `StageRunner` interface with a concrete `run()` method that: (1) calls abstract `executeTasks(ctx)` to run the stage's task phase, (2) runs checks serially, (3) on first check failure, dispatches the check's reaction (retry-task, auto-fix, escalate, ask-user), (4) on all-pass, returns success with nextStage. Subclasses override `executeTasks()`, `getChecks()`, `getNextStage()`, and `canHandle()`.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseStageRunner implements StageRunner interface
run() executes tasks → checks → reactions in sequence
Serial check execution: on first failure, remaining checks are skipped

auto-fix reaction runs the check's fix logic then re-runs the check
escalate reaction returns { success: false, escalateToStage: target }
ask-user reaction calls issueRepo.setApprovalState(id, { status: 'awaiting' }) before emitting approval_requested event
ask-user reaction returns { success: false } (pipeline pauses)
Typecheck passes
Unit tests for BaseStageRunner loop covering: all-pass, retry-task, escalate, ask-user scenarios
